svg.title: Core-2: AI and Tracking ERD
svg.desc: Operations owns AI recommendations and metrics. Tracking owns GPS history, latest locations, and ingestion receipts. Dashed references are not foreign-key constraints.
svg.text: The subject reference can identify a job.
Operations IDs are stored as references.
They have no cross-database foreign keys.
A separate service owns the GPS data.
AI records share the Operations database.
REF links are not foreign-key constraints.
PK: primary key FK: foreign key UK: unique REF: application reference ?: nullable
Solid line = database FK. Dashed line = reference only.
